text_simplified: This text discusses the rights of children upon their parents, mentioning several Prophetic hadiths that urge the proper tarbiyah (upbringing) of children and their care. It also highlights the importance of teaching them good akhlaq (character) and giving them attention. Parents must be a righteous example for their children.

review_defects.why: Arabic 'حسنة' means 'good', not necessarily 'righteous'; 'righteous' adds a religious quality not present in the original.
Arabic 'بعض' means 'some', not 'several'; 'several' implies a specific number greater than two, which is not in the source.
